conceptual_delta: Operationalize the three gaps as source-bound candidate discovery, controlled relation correction and same-construction composition-learning acceptance criteria; preserve the one hypergraph HSWM identity and FCL-1..8.
search_method: Bounded fresh primary-source search plus installed HF paper discovery; selected methods/assumptions read. Not systematic coverage, popularity ranking or conformance qualification.

sources.title: DreamCoder: Bootstrapping Inductive Program Synthesis with Wake-Sleep Library Learning
sources.read_depth: Paper abstract, project description and author repository
sources.finding: Learns reusable typed program-library abstractions from solved programs.
sources.limit: Assumes base language and task corpus; compression does not establish new grounded causal meaning.

sources.title: Top-Down Synthesis for Library Learning
sources.read_depth: Paper landing PDF and author repository/artifact README
sources.finding: Extracts abstractions that compress a collection of programs.
sources.limit: Existing syntax/semantics and cost model; HSWM needs execution equivalence and held-out outcome checks.

sources.title: Beyond identifiability: Learning causal representations with few environments and finite samples
sources.read_depth: Full arXiv HTML: abstract, Introduction, Model §2.1–2.2, Estimation opening §3.
sources.finding: Reconstructs target sets from dimensions of intersections of covariance column spaces across environments, then estimates B and graph using a generalized eigenvalue problem; it is not neural variable naming or open-ended semantic discovery.
sources.limit: Full-column-rank linear decoder; acyclic linear SEM; independent noise coordinates; observational environment; two noise-scale settings; strongly-separating unknown multi-target intervention design; distinct baseline noise-variance ratios; subgaussian X for finite-sample results. Recovery is up to label permutation and scale as specified by Theorem 2.1.

sources.title: InT: Self-Proposed Interventions Enable Credit Assignment in LLM Reasoning
sources.read_depth: Primary HTML Sections 2, 3.1-3.2, reference-solution ablations, Section 4 training opening
sources.finding: Reference-solution-conditioned first-error localization and single-step corrective intervention; evaluates continuation reward and trains on corrections.
sources.limit: Primarily incorrect traces; reference information is important. This does not solve all wrong relations in positive-reward traces, and supplied training solutions cannot become held-out evidence.

sources.title: Contextual Counterfactual Credit Assignment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in LLM Collaboration
sources.read_depth: Primary HTML Sections 2-3, fixed continuation Monte Carlo and LOO baseline; empirical/evaluation limitation passages
sources.finding: Compares context-matched alternative actions under a fixed continuation distribution and builds occurrence-level advantages.
sources.limit: Requires observable-context restoration and a defined continuation distribution/support. Fixed prefix does not eliminate downstream stochasticity. Marginal effects are not individual same-noise counterfactuals.

sources.title: DoWhy: Counterfactuals
sources.version: Versioned v0.13 documentation, not asserted latest
sources.read_depth: Official user-guide causal-task description and invertible-noise requirements
sources.finding: Individual counterfactual estimation requires stronger assumptions than interventional sampling, including recoverable noise in the documented mechanism.
sources.limit: Python method reference; refutation cannot prove causal assumptions. Missing exact replay does not prevent a separately designed prospective randomized average-effect experiment.

sources.title: The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?
sources.read_depth: Primary arXiv v2 abstract, Sections 1-5, theorem assumptions, experiments, and limitations.
sources.finding: Shows that, with arbitrary expressive alignment maps, high intervention-alignment scores can be vacuous: the paper proves an alignment can be constructed for nearly any neural network and target algorithm under stated assumptions, and reports 100% IIA for randomly initialized language models on IOI.
sources.limit: The theorem relies on input injectivity and strict output surjectivity and its construction overfits; these assumptions can fail. The result diagnoses unrestricted-map causal-abstraction evaluation and does not establish an HSWM mapping, causal mechanism, or task competence.
sources.code_status: Author-provided reproducibility code: https://github.com/densutter/non-linear-representation-dilemma ; identified from the paper, not downloaded, executed, or pinned.

sources.title: Bucketing the Good Apples: A Method for Diagnosing and Improving Causal Abstraction
sources.read_depth: Primary arXiv v1 abstract, causal-abstraction setup, Algorithms 1-2, experiments, and limitations.
sources.finding: Provides a finite diagnostic workflow: restrict to correctly handled low-level inputs, build a pairwise interchangeability graph, greedily extract high-density quasi-clique buckets, retain a residual bucket, then train a membership classifier for unseen in-distribution inputs.
sources.limit: It requires a prior task construal and candidate causal abstraction; it is structured program search rather than unconstrained automatic interpretation. Its greedy quasi-clique search is heuristic, experiments are mainly simple single-variable hypotheses, and interactions or accumulated approximation error can prevent large high-IIA buckets.
sources.code_status: Paper identifies code base: https://github.com/Paulineli/apple-bucket ; identified from the paper, not downloaded, executed, or pinned.

sources.title: Compositional abstraction error and a category of causal models
sources.finding: Finite interventional causal-model transformations admit compositional abstraction-error bounds in the proposed framework.
sources.limit: Does not prove that changing HSWM learners satisfy the model or preserve continual learning.

sources.title: Causal and Compositional Abstraction
sources.read_depth: Primary abstract only; HTML retrieval failed
sources.finding: Unifies causal abstractions using compositional models and strengthens component/mechanism-level abstraction.
sources.limit: Conceptual formal reference only; no claim of HSWM instantiation or adaptive-learning preservation.

sources.title: Model Uncertainty Quantification by Conformal Prediction in Continual Learning
sources.finding: Studies continual-learning calibration and reports an asymptotic CPCL coverage result.
sources.limit: Abstract-level candidate only; no finite-sample coverage claim under arbitrary drift or recursive composition.

sources.title: CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal Discovery Toward AI Scientists
sources.finding: Synthetic observation-intervention-hypothesis loop evaluates held-out prediction separately from hidden graph/equation recovery.
sources.limit: Supplies variable vocabulary and function family; finite linear/quadratic DAGs, shift interventions preserve incoming parent contributions. Does not test open-ended variable invention.

gaps.name: Experience-grounded variable and relation discovery
gaps.criterion: Seal initial program, generator/prompt/model revision, allowed read-set and primitive inventory before outcomes. Experience proposes an operational extractor/conditional relation absent from that declared initial inventory; evaluate untouched intervention/context predictions against an information/action/budget-matched strong text/program learner. Audit hidden extractors/answers in metadata. Novelty is relative to declared construction, not unknown LLM pretraining.
gaps.failure: Renaming, pre-embedded extractor, same-DSL path length, corpus compression or held-out leakage does not satisfy G1.

gaps.name: Correct a wrong relation despite positive terminal reward
gaps.criterion: Bind independent relation-wrongness evidence/access policy, pre-outcome prediction and frozen estimand; compare original/correction/remove/restore/sham and declared nuisance perturbation with arm-level actual outcomes. Preserve correct adjacent relations; qualifying credit must drive a schema/owner/provenance-bound canonical revision and fresh behavior.
gaps.failure: Positive reward, evaluator agreement, residual magnitude, or non-significance alone does not establish causal correction. Uncertain relation truth remains a competing-hypothesis study.

gaps.name: Preserve exceptions, uncertainty and learning under composition
gaps.criterion: After first-scale support, compose the same construction. Preserve conditional exceptions, shared evidence/dependence and calibration domains; compare actual/uniform/shuffled credit and a no-composition baseline matched for member computation, information, total budget and coordinator capacity. Measure fresh macro-to-micro learning and retention under joint-failure/shift slices.
gaps.failure: Nested execution, averaged confidence, erased residual buckets, extra-compute gains, or joint positive score alone does not satisfy G3. RED never satisfies first-scale support.

proposals.name: Freeze measurement and prediction contract
proposals.output: Immutable pre-outcome predictions and observation/evaluator/assignment ports; task, wrongness authority, holdout, generator, estimand, minimum relevant effect, budget and stopping policy. Every later proposal/assignment/evaluation/revision binds this contract hash.

proposals.name: Propose operational variables and conditional relations
proposals.output: Pure immutable extractor/relation proposals with source, condition, missingness, executable meaning, competing hypotheses and counterexamples; active discriminating experience. New research types must be mapped to schema-approved atoms before any canonical update.

proposals.name: Connect controlled correction to real canonical revision
proposals.output: Typed Effect replay or prospective randomized-assignment/evaluator ports, pure effect/uncertainty calculation, and existing canonical admission/journal integration through fresh behavior. Exact individual counterfactual and prospective average-effect estimands remain distinct.

proposals.name: Preserve conditional composition and connect formal premises
proposals.output: Same-construction typed contracts preserving exceptions, residual cases, shared evidence/dependence, calibration and revision lineage. Bound abstraction-map complexity; use untouched interventions and random/untrained controls. Design and counterexample preparation may precede first-scale outcome.

proposals.name: Measure two-scale learning and retention
proposals.start_condition: D-FIRST-SCALE SATISFIED; completing R-03 with RED or UNDERDETERMINED does not satisfy it.
proposals.output: Same-candidate macro/micro intervention outcomes, actual/uniform/shuffled credit, matched no-composition baseline, per-condition retention/calibration and shared-failure analysis; scoped negative outcomes preserved.

open_choices: Relation-truth/adjudication source and blinded evaluator/access policy
Sample size, estimand, minimum relevant effect, multiplicity/sequential analysis, total budget and stopping rule
Joint-uncertainty calibration and retention tradeoff thresholds

findings_addressed: Seal novelty comparison against initial generator/prompt/read-set/primitive bytes; qualify unknown pretraining.
Bind independent wrongness authority and access policy.
Bind frozen R-00 study contract hash through proposals, assignments, evaluation and canonical revisions.
Include matched no-composition baseline separate from credit ablations.
